mutations.replace: acc += s.x * s.x + s.y * s.y + s.z * s.z;

mutations.name: fused kernel forgets to write back the residual

cases.title: Dequant GEMV — why int4 is a decode-speed technique

mutations.name: int4 unpacking indexes weights instead of bytes
mutations.find: int k0 = 2 * b;
mutations.replace: int k0 = b;

mutations.name: int4 zero point applied to only one of the two nibbles
mutations.find: float w1 = ((float)(int)(packed >> 4) - z) * s;

mutations.name: int8 group scale indexed per element instead of per group
mutations.find: acc += (float)row[k] * rs[k / GROUP] * x[k];

cases.title: FP8 scaling — granularity, saturation and underflow

mutations.name: per-row amax scan skips half the row
mutations.find: for (int i = threadIdx.x; i < H; i += blockDim.x) amax = fmaxf(amax, fabsf(xr[i]));
mutations.replace: for (int i = threadIdx.x; i < H; i += 2 * blockDim.x) amax = fmaxf(amax, fabsf(xr[i]));

mutations.name: per-tensor quantize forgets to apply the scale
mutations.find: y[i] = to_e4m3(x[i] * scale) / scale;
mutations.replace: y[i] = to_e4m3(x[i]) / scale;

mutations.name: per-block amax scan skips half the group
mutations.find: for (int i = threadIdx.x; i < len; i += blockDim.x) amax = fmaxf(amax, fabsf(x[base + i]));
mutations.replace: for (int i = threadIdx.x; i < len; i += 2 * blockDim.x) amax = fmaxf(amax, fabsf(x[base + i]));

cases.title: All-reduce — ring vs direct, and the communication tax

mutations.name: all-gather forwards the chunk the reduce-scatter phase used
mutations.find: const int c = ((r + 1 - s) % R + R) % R;
mutations.replace: const int c = ((r - s) % R + R) % R;

mutations.name: naive all-reduce misses the last rank
mutations.find: for (int k = 0; k < R; ++k) acc += orig[(size_t)k * N + i];   // fixed order: reproducible
mutations.replace: for (int k = 0; k < R - 1; ++k) acc += orig[(size_t)k * N + i];  // fixed order

mutations.name: direct all-gather never delivers to rank 0
mutations.find: if (r != c) data[(size_t)r * N + (size_t)c * chunk + j] = v;
mutations.replace: if (r != c && r != 0) data[(size_t)r * N + (size_t)c * chunk + j] = v;

mutations.replace: for (int b = 0; b < DC - 1; ++b) s += sq[b] * sc[d * DC + b];   // latent-space score

mutations.name: absorbed path drops the decoupled RoPE term
mutations.find: for (int a = 0; a < DR; ++a) s += sqr[a] * k_r[(size_t)(j0 + d) * DR + a];  // RoPE part
mutations.replace: // RoPE term removed

mutations.name: query projection contracts over the wrong axis
mutations.find: for (int a = 0; a < DH; ++a) acc += q_nope[(size_t)h * DH + a] * W_UK[((size_t)h * DH + a) * DC + b];
mutations.replace: for (int a = 0; a < DH; ++a) acc += q_nope[(size_t)h * DH + a] * W_UK[((size_t)h * DH + a) * DC + (b + 1) % DC];
